summary: STORAGE_REGISTRY — a mountainash_settings.profiles.Registry instance for the 'storage' domain, constrained to StorageDescriptor spec types and StorageProfile profile types. Provides register decorator, get_spec(name), get_settings_class(name). get_descriptor() is a deprecated alias for get_spec().
extension_points: @register decorator registers a new provider settings class in STORAGE_REGISTRY
lifecycle_notes: get_descriptor() deprecated as of Phase 5 rename — warns DeprecationWarning, removed in 26.6.0
STORAGE_REGISTRY is separate from the backend runtime registry (storage_registry.registry) — it is for settings/spec lookup, not backend instantiation
documentation_hooks: Extension authors use @register to make their settings class discoverable via get_settings_class()
